newsitem.title: GERMANY: FOCUS-Linde hikes 96 dividend, profit up.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Linde hikes 96 dividend, profit up.

text.p: Europe's top forklift truckmaker Linde AG said on Thursday it plans to raise its 1996 dividend to 17.50 marks per share from 16 marks after net profit grew 10.4 percent to 395.9 million marks last year.
The group said the earnings rise stemmed exclusively from its operations outside Germany.
Pre-tax profit rose 11.1 percent to 689.1 million marks and earnings per share advanced 10.3 percent to 44.10 marks, Linde said in a statement.
Incoming orders rose four percent to 8.9 billion marks. Group sales rose 6.2 percent to 8.8 billion marks.

The results marked an improvement from the first nine months when new orders had advanced just 1.8 percent amid sluggish demand in Germany for goods handling equipment, its biggest division, and industrial gases.

The news gave a short-lived boost to the company's shares which rose as high as 1,170 marks, up 32 marks or 2.8 percent. But they rapidly lost their gains and were quoted at 1,130 marks in late afternoon trade.
All four business sections -- engineering and contracting, material handling equipment like forklift trucks, refrigeration and industrial gases improved sales, Linde said.
Total investment rose to a new record of 1.1 billion marks from 933 million, the company said.
The global workforce rose by 2.3 percent to 30,746 last year. Linde said it had 13,569 staff abroad, up 7.3 percent.
